# Unit test for function move_one_ball
def test_move_one_ball():
    # empty and single element
    assert move_one_ball([]) == True
    assert move_one_ball([1]) == True

    # already sorted
    assert move_one_ball([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == True
    assert move_one_ball([1, 2]) == True

    # sortable by rotation
    assert move_one_ball([3, 4, 5, 1, 2]) == True
    assert move_one_ball([4, 5, 1, 2, 3]) == True
    assert move_one_ball([2, 1]) == True
    assert move_one_ball([2, 2, 1, 2]) == True
    assert move_one_ball([2, 1, 2]) == True

    # not sortable by rotation
    assert move_one_ball([1, 3, 2]) == False
    assert move_one_ball([3, 2, 1]) == False
    assert move_one_ball([5, 4, 3, 2, 1]) == False
    assert move_one_ball([2, 3, 1, 4]) == False
    assert move_one_ball([1, 2, 1]) == False
